title: Billing history import
subtitle: Bring customers, plans, subscriptions, invoices, payments and usage from Chargebee, Recurly, Maxio or Zuora into OpenBooks, then reconcile before cut-over.
emptyBody: Connect a billing platform to pull its full history. Review the preflight, map plans and customers, import, and reconcile MRR, open AR and deferred revenue before cut-over.
accountPlaceholder: Site name or account, e.g. acme
attentionEmpty: Everything maps cleanly — the import can proceed unattended.
tiesNo: Reconciliation has differences — review before cut-over
requestFailed: The billing platform did not answer.
